questions.prompt: Which Australian jellyfish has a cube-shaped bell and a deadly sting?

questions.prompt: Lifeguards in northern Australia pour what on box jellyfish stings?
questions.explain: Vinegar stops unfired stinging cells from firing. Always follow local first-aid advice.

questions.prompt: The Portuguese man o' war is a single animal.
